nodes.title: lamp2 (painted mouth/eye/brow keys swapped, rigid head motion only) failed the blind gates after 3 polish rounds: final build uncanny 2/10 pooled (bar <= 1/5), premium 2.8 vs r8 3.2-3.6 in the same runs; same person 5/5, childish 0/5; kill rule applied, held

lamp2 blind judges, 6 runs x n=5 (3 gpt-5.6-sol + 2 Kimi K2.6), lamp1 prompt, r8 in every run: uncanny 3,2,0,2,2,2 /5; premium 2.6,2.8,2.6,2.4,2.8,2.8; r8 uncanny 1,0,0,0,0,1 /5, premium 3.0-3.6; identical images scored 0/5 then 2/5

24-line Diya battery, product timing path into the lamp2 mouth keys: bilabial words sealed 132/132 with the lamp2 text rule (every b/m/p letter Azure left unsealed), 121/132 with lamp1's rule, 82/132 from Azure visemes alone
lamp2 key mouth vs the forced-alignment timing (E3, 21 lines): +55 ms median without a lead; with KEY_LEAD_MS 35: median +15 ms, IQR -10..+50, 57% within +-50 ms (continuous viseme jaw +10 ms, 95%)

lamp2 KeyRig (Canvas 2D, prescaled layer caches): 80 px row 60 fps at 4x CPU throttle, desk 375x405 49.3 fps at 4x (lamp1 10.5), headless Chromium; pack 133 KB wire; rest SSIM 0.989; keys SSIM outside region 1.0

src/face-puppet/rig-keys: KeyRig (a RigLike the unchanged PuppetDriver drives) + schedule.ts (viseme->painted mouth, 45 ms crossfade, 70 ms hold, own blink schedule, gaze key swaps, rigid motion caps); pack art/character/puppet2d/lamp2

A painted semi-realistic head may roll at most ~1.2 deg rigidly: at a 2 deg cap (J1-J2) and 1.5 deg + glance sway (J4) blind judges read 'proportions swim' / features sliding; at 1.2 deg (J3) uncanny 0/5

The remaining lamp2 complaints are mouth interiors differing key to key and limited motion: try painting all mouths as ONE image (a model sheet sharing teeth) or artist-drawn mouths, and painted 3/4 head keys cut-swapped; re-judge with r8 in the same run

md.rejected:
## rj-r4-lamp2-painted-keys-premium
**Tried (2026-10-10, round 4 rig2, docs/design/round4/asha/rig2/):** the grown-up Asha (option 4, cardigan + print kurta) as PAINTED KEYS instead of lamp1's mesh warp: 10 mouths, 5 eye keys and 2 brow keys, each an Azure gpt-image-2 edit of the approved rig-b front, registered and composited only inside its region (SSIM outside 1.0); swapped with 45 ms crossfades by a Canvas 2D KeyRig the unchanged PuppetDriver drives; rigid head motion only (roll <= 1.2 deg). **Broke:** blind judges (lamp1's prompt, 3 gpt-5.6-sol + 2 Kimi K2.6, r8 in every run): uncanny 3, 2, 0, 2 /5 over J1-J4, the final build 2/10 pooled (identical images 0/5 then 2/5); premium 2.4-2.8 vs r8 3.0-3.6 in the same runs. Named: mouth interiors differ key to key (each mouth repainted from scratch), a still head, the thinking glance; more rigid motion (P3) brought 'proportions swim' back. Passed: same person 5/5, childish 0/5, rest SSIM 0.989, pack 133 KB, 60 fps at 4x on the 80 px row (headless), bilabials 132/132 on the 24-line battery (lamp2 text rule), calm safety face, lip-sync median +15 ms. Kill rule applied after 3 polish rounds; lamp2 is a HELD look, r8 stays live. **Reverse if:** a painted-key build passes uncanny <= 1/5 AND premium >= r8's same-run score in two consecutive rounds of the same panel (lead: one mouth model sheet sharing teeth, op-r4-asha-mouth-model-sheet).
